original:

  { $lookup: { from: "Municipality", localField: "municipality", foreignField: "_id", as: "m" } },
  { $unwind: "$m" },
  { $lookup: { from: "Settlement", localField: "m.settlement", foreignField: "_id", as: "s" } },

])

db.Region.aggregate([
  { $lookup: { from: "Municipality", localField: "municipality", foreignField: "_id", as: "m" } },

  { $lookup: { from: "Settlement", localField: "m.settlement", foreignField: "_id", as: "s" } },

description: Средний возраст госпитализированных по социальным группам
original:
db.Instances.aggregate([
  { $lookup: { from: "Therapy", localField: "therapy", foreignField: "_id", as: "t" } },
  { $unwind: "$t" },
  { $match: { "t.hospitalization": true } },
  { $lookup: { from: "Pdtient", localField: "patient", foreignField: "_id", as: "p" } },
  { $unwind: "$p" },
  { $lookup: { from: "Social_group", localField: "p.social_group", foreignField: "_id", as: "s" } },
  { $unwind: "$s" },
  { $group: { _id: "$s.type", avg_age: { $avg: "$p.age" } } }
])
mongo:
db.Instances.aggregate([
  { $lookup: { from: "Therapy", localField: "therapy", foreignField: "_id", as: "t" } },
  { $unwind: "$t" },
  { $match: { "t.hospitalization": true } },
  { $lookup: { from: "Patient", localField: "patient", foreignField: "_id", as: "p" } },
  { $unwind: "$p" },
  { $lookup: { from: "Social_group", localField: "p.social_group", foreignField: "_id", as: "s" } },
  { $unwind: "$s" },
  { $group: { _id: "$s.type", avg_age: { $avg: "$p.age" } } }
])
original_sql: SELECT s.type, AVG(p.age) FROM Pdtient p JOIN Social_group s ON p.social_group = s._id JOIN Instances i ON i.patient = p._id JOIN Therapy t ON i.therapy = t._id WHERE t.hospitalization = true GROUP BY s.type;
